fusions.name: Webbed Mycelium
fusions.desc: Strings a web of mycelium 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 9 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Spore
fusions.desc: Spins a spore on a silk line that deals 7 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. You hold 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Buried Tripwire
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to lay a snare that stays armed for 40 seconds. The first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles of it take 18 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Webcap Familiar
fusions.desc: A bonded webcap familiar fights beside you, striking an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each strike leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
